text: I successfully fetched the quickstart and created the Next.js app (`npx create-next-app@latest my-copilot-app` completed with exit code 0). Node.js v25.9.0 and npm 11.12.1 were verified working. However, I got stuck at the "Install CopilotKit packages" step: `npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/react-ui @copilotkit/runtime` repeatedly failed with exit code 137 (OOM) initially, and even when subsequent attempts appeared to complete, the packages were not added to `package.json` dependencies and the installed directories in `node_modules/@copilotkit/` (e.g., `react-core/`, `runtime/`) contained empty `dist/` folders or only `node_modules` subdirectories. Because the packages were not properly installed, I could not proceed to create the API route, configure the layout/page components, or build the app. I did create the `.env` file as instructed.
